origin.description: Weighted rotation and translation that align two point sets.

arguments.name: B
arguments.text: Points to align, same size as A.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Column weights. Equal weights when omitted.

origin.details: Align a 2 by 3 point set with equal weights.
origin.value: Weighted rotation and translation that align two point sets.
origin.example: local({A<-matrix(1:6, 2, 3); B<-matrix(c(2, 1, 4, 3, 6, 5), 2, 3); with(kabsch(A, B), c(U, R, d))})

translation.description: Weighted rotation and translation that align two point sets.

arguments.name: B
arguments.text: Points to align, same size as A.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: Column weights. Equal weights when omitted.

translation.details: Align a 2 by 3 point set with equal weights.
translation.value: Weighted rotation and translation that align two point sets.
translation.example: (lambda z: np.concatenate([np.ravel(z['U'], order='F'), np.ravel(z['R'], order='F'), np.ravel(z['d'])]))(kabsch(np.array([1,2,3,4,5,6], dtype=float).reshape((2, 3), order='F'), np.array([2,1,4,3,6,5], dtype=float).reshape((2, 3), order='F')))
